newsitem.title: USA: Infocure Corp IPO postponed -- underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Infocure Corp IPO postponed -- underwriter.

text.p: The initial public offering in Infocure Corp was postponed due to market conditions, lead underwriter Rodman & Renshaw Inc said on Friday.

Earlier this week the company changed the proposed price range for the initial public offering to a target price of $7 from a proposed price range of $8 to $10. However, the proposed number of shares remains at two million.
The initial public offering was expected to trade on Friday.
Infocure Corp is a medical software company.
